title: costroid.yml
description: The repository's one Costroid configuration file. Every key is optional, and a repository with no file gets the defaults. The report reads this file at the head of the pull request's base branch, so a pull request cannot change its own settings.

comment.description: The sticky comment on a pull request.

show_cost.description: Whether a public repository's comment prints amounts. Off, it shows the verdict and the grades, and the rows and the check run's machine block keep the amounts. A private repository always prints them.

policy.description: What the check holds each run to. The report reads these keys at the head of the pull request's base branch, so a pull request cannot change its own verdict.

run_budget_usd.description: The budget each run is held to, in USD, as a whole number or a quoted decimal. A run over it warns during the warn-only period and fails after it. Rows the agent's job wrote cannot show a run under it, so on that path the rule concludes neutral at best.

max_run_cost_usd.description: A ceiling on one run's cost at list, in USD, as a whole number or a quoted decimal. It is held the same way as the budget.

max_increase_usd.description: How far a run may cost more than the median of this agent's earlier runs, in USD, as a whole number or a quoted decimal. The rule needs 10 or more earlier runs, and until a baseline reaches the check it does not run.

max_increase_percent.description: How far a run may cost more than the median of this agent's earlier runs, in percent, as a whole number or a quoted decimal. The rule needs 10 or more earlier runs, and until a baseline reaches the check it does not run.

pr_budget_usd.description: The budget a pull request's runs are held to together, in USD, as a whole number or a quoted decimal. The report adds this run to the total of the pull request's earlier runs, read from their costroid check runs. Where that total cannot be read, or may count one report twice, the rule concludes unproven.

monthly_budget_usd.description: The budget the repository's runs are held to over a calendar month, in USD, as a whole number or a quoted decimal. The month to date comes only from a ledger, and none reaches the check yet, so the rule does not run.

models.description: The models a run may use: exact model ids, or a prefix that ends in *. A run that used another model warns during the warn-only period and fails after it.

enforce.description: true ends the warn-only period now, so a rule that fails fails the check. Without it the period runs for 7 days from the commit that added the workflow to the base branch.

approval.description: Who can turn a failed check neutral by approving the pull request in a review, and for how long. A review counts only on the pull request's head commit, from an account that can write to the repository and is not an App. The report and costroid approve read these keys at the head of the pull request's base branch.

allow_author.description: Whether the pull request's author can approve it.

expires_days.description: How many days after it was submitted a review approves the head it names. A new push ends an approval sooner.

policy_pack.description: The policy pack this repository is held to. Reserved: this release reads no pack.

budget_owner.description: Who answers for this repository's budget, as an SCM login or team. Reserved: this release reads no owner.

assumptions.description: Assumption defaults for static estimates. Reserved: this release makes no estimate, so the keys inside are not defined yet.

catalog.description: The price catalog version to pin. Reserved: this release uses the catalog it embeds.

agents.description: The agents that run in CI. Reserved: the workflow decides this today.
